{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Compute total number of unique patients
total_patients = len(deduplicated_data)
print(total_patients)

# Compute number of patients with severe baseline disease
severe_patients = deduplicated_data['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
print(severe_patients)

# Compute fraction
fraction_severe = severe_patients / total_patients
print(fraction_severe)"}
